cohort.alarm: gate score >= threshold, primary subset, scorable rows
cohort.alarm_time_t: T4: first alarm hour of the episode whose (t-24h, t] window has >= 18 of 24 points for USFLUX and TOTUSJH
cohort.delayed: no M1+ in (t, t+24h], >= 1 M1+ from the HARP's region in (t+24h, t+48h], window free of label-missing days
cohort.episode: T1: consecutive alarm hours merged across <= 3 missing/unscorable hours; ends at a scored hour below threshold or > 3 missing hours
cohort.history: n_C, n_M, n_X in [t-48h, t) (identical to (t-48h, t] here)
cohort.trends: least-squares slope vs hours over (t-24h, t] divided by the window mean; USFLUX and TOTUSJH; >= 18 points
cohort.unit: T2: all eligible episodes; weight 1/(eligible episodes in HARP)

data.labels: K2 (true irradiance scale), SWPC original event reports
data.unscorable_rule: rows with any gate feature missing get no gate score; excluded from alarms and metrics

exploratory: delayed alarms: descriptive only if < 10 matched pairs

gate.cv: 5-fold grouped by HARP, 3 K2 strata, seed 20260921
gate.scaling: per training fold: subtract median, divide by standard deviation (B&C 2015 sec. 5)
gate.test_metrics: TSS, HSS, FAR at hour level and region level; TSS with HARP-bootstrap 95% CI, 1,000 resamples
gate.test_score: mean of the 5 fold models' decision values; no refit
gate.threshold_rule: max TSS on pooled out-of-fold hourly dev scores (primary subset)
gate.training_rows: dev single-region rows at TAI hours {4,10,16,22}

matched_pairs.caliper_rule: 0.2 x SD of gate score over the dev cohort episodes
matched_pairs.matching: 1:1 greedy nearest on gate score, without replacement, false alarm from a different HARP, seeded order

models.cv: 5-fold grouped by HARP, 2 strata (>= 1 true episode / none), seed 20260921
models.estimator: LogisticRegression(penalty='l2', C=1.0, solver='lbfgs', max_iter=10000), no tuning
models.primary_metric: weighted log-loss(A) - log-loss(B) on the primary test years; HARP-bootstrap 95% CI, 10,000 resamples
models.secondary: weighted AUC for A and B
models.test_prediction: APPROVED by user 2026-09-21: mean of the 5 fold models' predicted probabilities; no refit
